chapter: Bix, Trumbauer and the Goldkette sidemen
title: The Greystone's collapse and Charlie Horvath's bankruptcy
summary: Virginia says her brother Charlie spent $160,000 renovating the Greystone, lost everything in the crash, and moved on to Cleveland and California.

story.theme_name: Making a living: hard times, day jobs and scarce work
story.community_name: The Depression years and the WPA band

blocks.x: They used to come to Cleveland, with my brother. My brother was Joel. And he after the Greystone...I don't know if you want to record this stuff.
After the Greystone, well the Depression came.
And my brother went bankrupt at the Greystone. He had just sunk $160,000 into renovating.
In renovating the Greystone. He built outdoor gardens in '28, partly, the latter part of
And that's when the crash came. So he lost everything and went bankrupt.
Then he went to Cleveland and opened another ballroom. And then he used to book all these boys, that he was trying...
He was trying to keep these talented men together.
But everything kept going down and down and down.
What was he doing in California?
Well just hustling around and playing his jazz.
